pages.text: The heat cell inside every ORSA heating device.$(br2)$(bold)Used in:$() Thermal Heater, Geothermal Core, O2 Canister, Acheron Forge, Transponder.
Needs blaze powder. Get blaze rods from the Nether early; you will not want to go back later.$(br2)$(italic)Designed as a hand warmer. Then it heated a room. Engineering calls this "scope creep."$()
Iron ingot, blaze powder on three sides, magma cream below. Do not taste the magma cream. Kevin tasted the magma cream.
